snippet.title: "WIXOSS Multiverse"New Trailer Out Now!
snippet.description:
"WIXOSS Multiverse" Major Update Now Live!

WIXOSS Multiverse is an instant-play RPG inspired by the massively popular trading card game (TCG) WIXOSS. Available exclusively on the G123 game platform, the game can be enjoyed instantly on smartphone or PC—no download, no installation, no barriers.

Play Now: https://s.g123.jp/8t8s8x8w

■Basic Info
Game Title: WIXOSS Multiverse
Type: RPG
Price: Free to play (in-game purchases available)
